Commentary.Commentary: We are back. Max O'Dowd and Vikramjit Singh to open for Netherlands. Tendai Chatara to start with the ball.
...THE CHASE...

The start wasn't that good for Netherlands and it cost them. In phases, they were quite wayward but Shariz Ahmad was standout from all of them. Once he was introduced into the attack, Netherlands got better of Zimbabwe but they fail to capitalize on it and allowed a stand to build which as result, they not have to chase a par score on this pitch. No doubt, Shariz Ahmad was the pick with his five-fer. Netherlands have to chase to win the series. Their batting needs to pick up the form. Can Netherlands chase this down? We will find out soon.

A decent performance from Zimbabwe but they had a chance to reach the 300-mark at one point. It was a good pitch to bat on and Zimbabwe good start. But once Ervine fell, Zimbabwe nose dived and were reeling at 120 for 5 at one stage. However, then came the big partnership between Sean Williams and Clive Madande of more than 100 which helped Zimbabwe get back on track. Both got their fifty but fell probably at a very long time just when they had the momentum. Still, Zimbabwe will be happy with this score.

TOSS - Zimbabwe have won the toss and ELECTED TO BAT!

The first game was an absolute hundinger of a match, it swung like a pendulum quite a few times but in thr end, it was Zimbabwe who won thanks to a magical knock from Teja Nidamanuru. It is now time for the second ODI and it is a must-win for the hosts. A win for the visitors will see them seal the series. Everything to play for, this promises to ve a cracker too. Stay tuned.
... MATCH DAY ...

It is time for the 2nd ODI of the three-match series of the Netherlands tour of Zimbabwe. The visitors came out on top in the 1st ODI and it was a tight one. The game came down to the wire where the hosts lost the game with just one ball left. They will look to improve on their batting side as they were bundled out for 249 in their allotted fifty overs. Their top order failed to deliver runs on the board and that is what cost them the game. Craig Ervine will look for a better performance with the bat in this game. Their bowling unit performed well but just fell short of a few runs. For the visitors, Teja Nidamanuru was the star of the show as he scored an unbeaten 110. Colin Ackermann was dismissed for a half-century and Paul van Meekeren scored a quickfire 21 to get their team over the line. Their bowling unit performed well too. They will be hoping to repeat it and win this series. Can they do it? Or will the hosts bounce back and level tthe series? We shall find out together.
